title: The Letter from Mr. Hale
海爾先生的來信
paras: Ivy had lived in Apartment 4B for two years, and she wanted to stay. In May, a letter arrived from her {{landlord|landlord}}, Mr. Hale. Her {{lease|lease}} would {{expire|expire}} on June 30, it said, and the monthly {{rental|rental}} rate for the next year would go up by $150.
艾薇在 4B 號公寓住了兩年，也想繼續住下去。五月，房東海爾先生寄來一封信。信上說，她的租約將在六月三十日到期，而且明年每月的租金要調漲一百五十美元。

That evening she called him. "I've never paid a day late," she said. "I think I'm a good {{tenant|tenant}}." "You are," Mr. Hale said. "But my costs went up, too. If you'd rather not sign the {{renewal|renewal}}, I understand. You'd just need to {{vacate|vacate}} the apartment by the thirtieth, so I can get it ready for someone new."
那天晚上她打電話給他。「我從來沒有晚繳過一天，」她說，「我覺得我是個不錯的房客。」「確實是，」海爾先生說，「但我的成本也上漲了。如果妳不想簽續約，我能理解，只是妳得在三十號前搬出去，我才能把房子整理好給下一位住戶。」

Ivy took a breath. "What if I sign for two years? I'd want a smaller increase, and a new refrigerator. It's the only {{appliance|appliance}} in the kitchen that keeps breaking down." "Seventy-five dollars more a month," he said. "I'll order the refrigerator."
艾薇深吸了一口氣。「如果我簽兩年呢？我希望漲幅小一點，還要換一台新冰箱。那是廚房裡唯一一直壞掉的電器。」「每個月多七十五美元，」他說，「冰箱我來訂。」

"One more thing," Ivy said. "My brother Max is moving in this summer, and the lease lists me as the only {{occupant|occupant}}. He also has a small dog. I know the building doesn't allow {{pet|pets}}, but Biscuit only weighs twelve pounds." Mr. Hale laughed. "Twelve pounds I can live with. Send me Max's name and I'll add it, plus a two-hundred-dollar deposit for the dog." Ivy hung up, smiling.
「還有一件事，」艾薇說，「我弟弟麥克斯夏天要搬來住，而租約上只登記我一個住戶。他還養了一隻小狗。我知道這棟樓不准養寵物，可是小餅乾才十二磅重。」海爾先生笑了。「十二磅，我還能接受。把麥克斯的名字寄給我，我會加進去，另外狗要收兩百美元押金。」艾薇笑著掛上電話。
